tools.name: coverage
tools.description: FREE. How many x402 seller hosts and remote MCP servers BotsRated covers (mcp_servers: servers, hosts, probed, last-state counts), from which discovery sources, the probe schedules and when the last probe runs finished.

tools.name: sample
tools.description: FREE. Returns a real sample of a paid response (check, report or best) for a fixed example, so you can see exactly what you would buy.

tools.name: check
tools.description: PAID $0.001 USDC on Base mainnet (the first 100 HTTP calls per client per UTC day are free) via x402 HTTP. Measured facts for one host (an x402 seller, or a remote MCP server host: handshake state, protocol version, tools count/hash and change history, auth needed, latency): valid-402 rate, latency

tools.name: report
tools.description: PAID $0.002 USDC on Base mainnet (the first 10 HTTP calls per client per UTC day are free) via x402 HTTP. Full receipt history for one host (up to 1000 probes plus all paid test-buys). Returns the x402 URL to GET; does not pay.

description.name: botsrated_policy_check
description.description: FREE, never charged. Your own pass / warn / block rules applied to BotsRated measurements. Private to your plan or org key: until MCP auth ships this tool checks your arguments and answers bearer_required; call POST /v1/policy/check with your Bearer token. decision null means no answer, never a pass

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "botsrated_policy_check" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: FREE, never charged. Your own pass / warn / block rules applied to BotsRated measurements. Private to your plan or org key: until MCP auth ships this tool check…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find, botsrated_policy_check · Private data: botsrated_policy_check · Public sink: botsrated_policy_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find, botsrated_policy_check · Private data: botsrated_policy_check · Public sink: botsrated_policy_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "preflight" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
